patterns.title: Fix a vulnerable transitive sharp chain by updating glTF Transform and locking npm
patterns.pattern: Inspect actual imports, dependency graph and runtime package manifest. Preserve glTF APIs while replacing the upstream chain with @gltf-transform/core, extensions and functions ^4.5.1, whose functions package depends on ndarray-pixels ^5.2.0 and thus sharp ^0.35.0. Remove the unused direct sharp version, update Node engine floor to >=20.9.0, generate the native npm v3 lockfile, npm ci from that ex

patterns.title: Read Blender geometry from the evaluated depsgraph, not obj.data
patterns.pattern: After modifiers, read vertices/bbox/normals via evaluated_mesh(depsgraph, obj) (or equivalent depsgraph evaluate). Re-fetch bpy.types.ID pointers after undo or Edit/Object mode toggle.

patterns.title: Guide Blender agents from task intent to canonical tools before scene changes
patterns.pattern: Retain a compact MCP goal/search/schema/execute surface. Surface task guidance at goal and search, attach the relevant guide at schema inspection, prefer complete named workflows when matched, validate exact canonical keys and parameters before forwarding, and check live Blender scene changes, render and export artifacts. Keep all pre-existing canonical handlers behind discovery, not new generic e

patterns.title: Crash-retried Blender background render with RQ and atomic PNG publication
patterns.pattern: Use RQ's Redis-backed Queue.enqueue with Retry(max=1), a single worker's forked workhorse, and StartedJobRegistry cleanup. Enable Redis AOF with a dedicated local broker. Accept only saved authorized .blend scenes, execute an official Blender background process with autoexec disabled, render to a UUID-job-specific temporary PNG, verify PNG bytes, atomically replace the stable output, and permit id

patterns.title: Cursor MCP stdio must pin a Node that has node:sqlite
patterns.pattern: Launcher probes import('node:sqlite') on nvm 22.13+ first. Never prepend /usr/local/bin ahead of that Node. Do not put GITHUB_TOKEN in mcp.json. Load tokens from .env after the process starts.
